messages:
maria: Quick note - preview-ledger shows a small uptick (~2.8%) in token counts after last night's hedging TTL change. pattern looks like duplicate hedged emissions when a late session join arrives. anyone have shadow observations? :eyes:
ajay: I noticed similar in shadow around 02:12 UTC. reproducing locally with synthetic long-session traffic. hypothesis: hedging flag set during preproc and the later join emits a merged event that isn't collapsed, so ledger sees both. hedging logic lives in two places: route_preproc and tally_merge.
devon: that's consistent with an old race. when aggregator windows overlap a session_id can be mapped to a new join_id and both get emitted. ledger dedupe currently keys by join_id only which misses pre-join cases.
kevin: short mitigation: add dedupe by (session_id, request_fingerprint) at aggregator output so the preview pipeline doesn't double-count. longer-term we should canonicalize join_id assignment earlier.
li: I can run a tenant breakdown. run this on preview db:```sql
SELECT tenant_id, route, count(*) dupes
FROM preview_events
WHERE hedged = true
  AND received_at > now() - interval '90 minutes'
GROUP BY tenant_id, route
ORDER BY dupes DESC
LIMIT 30;
```
ajay: ran query in shadow - top affected routes are streaming.chat.v1 and stream-gen.large. tenants: infra-tools (58), analytics-svc (21), content-prod (9). mostly long-lived streams with intermittent rejoin events.
ops-bot: /alert preview-ledger-dup spike=2.8pct env=shadow scope=preview
sre-bot: deploy-bot: aggregator hotfix build ready (dedupe-session-fingerprint)  will canary at 5% by kevin. ETA 8m.
kevin: deploying canary now. am adding temporary metric: hedged_preview_duplicates and a rollback flag on the release. will watch (1m/5m/15m) windows.
maria: please also add a console card for hedged_preview_duplicates / hedged_preview_total by route and tenant. set alert that fires at > 5 dupes sustained for 10m for top-10 tenants.
devon: adding a unit/integration regression: simulate pre-join hedged emission + late join and assert ledger has single charge. pseudo:```py
# pre-join emitted event
emit_preview(session_id='s1', hedged=True, fingerprint='f1')
# time passes, join creates join_id j1 mapping s1
emit_join(join_id='j1', session_ids=['s1'])
# aggregator should collapse to a single output
assert ledger.charges(join_id='j1') == 1
```
ajay: also added an E2E smoke harness that replays 1h of production-like stream traces with rejoin injections to validate no dupes in preview mode. pushing to shadow-runner.
kevin: canary metrics: hedged_preview_duplicates dropped from 40->0 in canary slice within 3 minutes. promoting to 25% now, will ramp to 100% over 20m.
ops-bot: /alert resolution preview-ledger-dup resolved env=shadow scope=preview
maria: thanks all. filing a retro item: "verify canonical join semantics for hedged flows" and CS escalation note for tenants we saw. will monitor next invoice-preview run. :white_check_mark:
